verdict.rationale: Weaviate's quickstart docs explicitly name official client libraries in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java, and the quickstart flow builds against them. A community user also notes Weaviate can run as an embedded Python package, which loosely corroborates hands-on Python use. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference evidence (feature coverage, async support, versioning), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality beyond the single install-instructions mention.
